window_unit: Each of five dates receives equal weight; grid cells are not independent replicates
upper_definition: Descriptive fixed native interfaces 20..28, not fixed km heights
near_400_500_definition: Interfaces whose GLOBAL median reference ZG lies between 400 and 500 km at that target time; mean of per-layer metrics, no geometric-height interpolation
global_region_stats: cos latitude weighted RMS/log RMS; spatial P95 is unweighted percentile
